name: AI untuk Rakyat Programme
benefits: Free foundational AI micro-courses and 3-month premium AI tools subscription for eligible youth.
notes: Open to all Malaysians; 3-month free AI tool subscription is restricted to citizens aged 18-30 who complete all 6 prescribed courses (100k quota from 31 Aug 2026). (基础AI课全民免费，18-30岁青年完成6门课享3个月免费AI工具)

name: Global Learning Pass
benefits: Complimentary 3-month access to 16,000+ Coursera courses and Professional Certificates.
notes: Must activate within 16 days of approval or pass is revoked; Cohort 1 (25,000 slots from 16 Sept 2026) is fully subscribed with waitlist active for subsequent cohorts. (免费享3个月Coursera专业课程与证书，第一批2.5万名额已满，目前开放候补)

name: PERKESO EIS Training Programme
benefits: Fully funded professional training tuition plus up to RM20 daily training allowance.
notes: Requires active PERKESO EIS contributor status and verified loss of employment via EIS / MYFutureJobs portal. (全额资助学费并提供每日最高RM20津贴)

name: HRD Corp e-LATiH
benefits: Free access to over 1,000 foundational online courses covering digital, business, and workplace skills.
notes: Over 1,000 foundational courses are completely free to all Malaysians; paid Premium Courses are also hosted on the platform. (基础专区逾千门课程完全免费，亦含部分付费高级课程)

name: PENJANA KPT-PACE
benefits: Provides up to RM3,000 training and certification vouchers for local tertiary students and graduates when cohorts are active.
notes: Administered via participating Malaysian public and private universities; previous documented cohorts ran 2022-2024 and late-2026 intake status is unconfirmed. (高教部最高RM3,000专业认证代金券，往期为2022-2024，2026批次待确认)

name: Peneraju Profesional Perakaunan (Accounting)
benefits: Full convertible financing for professional accounting tuition and exams plus monthly living allowance for full-time trainees.
notes: Bumiputera citizens only (quarterly quota allocation; requires ALTI offer letter); convertible financing is exempted from repayment upon passing exams. (全额资助学费考费及津贴，限土著公民)

name: National Structured Internship Programme (MySIP)
benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly internship allowance for students and double tax deduction for host employers.
notes: Minimum RM600/month for Master's/Degree/DLKM and RM500/month for Diploma/SKM interns across approved 10-week internships on MyNext. (学生获月度保障实习津贴：本科/硕士最低RM600，文凭最低RM500)

name: Global Online Workforce (GLOW) Malaysia
benefits: Free 3-day intensive training and mentoring to help Malaysians earn income as global digital freelancers.
notes: Open to Malaysians aged 18+ outside formal employment, retrenched / >30% salary cut, or unemployed/underemployed graduates with technical skills. (免费指导大马待业/减薪或自由职业公民成为国际数字自由职业者)

name: K-Youth Development Programme (K-Youth)
benefits: Fully funded short-term skills acceleration, paid on-the-job apprenticeship, and industry certification for youth.
notes: Multi-track national youth employability initiative (Accelerate, Nurture, Optimise) pairing classroom training with paid workplace placement. (国库控股青年就业培训与带薪实习计划，面向18-30岁大马青年)

name: Women's Career Comeback Programme (CCP)
benefits: Free career readiness workshops, coaching, employer matching, and personal income tax exemption eligibility upon returning to work.
notes: For Malaysian women professionals with at least 3 years of prior work experience who have been on a career break for more than 6 months. (TalentCorp女性重返职场计划，享免费培训、名企配对及个人所得税减免)

name: MYMidCareer40
benefits: Free AI-assisted career matching, personalized career counseling, interview coaching, and funded reskilling courses for job seekers aged 40 and above.
notes: Tailored mid-career transition and skills upgrade programme under MYFutureJobs and PERKESO for Malaysians aged 40+. (社险机构MYFutureJobs专为40岁及以上中年求职与转行者提供的免费技能提升与就业配对计划)

name: Young Employable Students (YES!)
benefits: Free certified career coaching, communication and problem-solving bootcamps, resume clinics, and direct networking with top Malaysian employers.
notes: Graduate employability intervention programme run in collaboration with local universities, TVET institutions, and industry partners. (TalentCorp本地大专与技职生职场竞争力提升训练营，完全免费)

name: PERKESO Return To Work (RTW) Programme
benefits: Fully funded vocational retraining, physical rehabilitation, assistive devices, workplace modification, and job placement support.
notes: For PERKESO insured persons recovering from employment injury or invalidity who require vocational reskilling, entrepreneurship support (RTWPreneur), or job placement. (PERKESO工伤及伤残受保人免费职业技能重塑与重返职场辅助计划)
